sources.snippet: The Taxi-v3 environment simulates a simple grid world where the agent (taxi) needs to pick up passengers from one location and drop them off at another while navigating obstacles on the grid. The agent learns to accomplish this task efficiently by employing Q-learning, a popular reinforcement learning algorithm.
